steps.headline: The contract, graded — accept these verdicts?

rows.statement: One page visit connects page loads, install-instructions opens and final download clicks using a temporary random label kept only in the open page.
Reloading or opening another tab starts a new visit, without analytics cookies, a saved visitor ID or a fingerprint.
Website activity stays separate from app device records, without identifying unique people or tracking them across days.
The website privacy notice discloses website measurement without a visitor opt-out.
Create labeled links lets you enter a source and campaign name, then copy a labeled youcoded.ai link for each marketing post.
Website measurement records only approved campaign labels and the referring site's domain, never full referring URLs.
Campaign measurement starts with future visits, cannot recover old traffic, and keeps a shared link's original campaign label when shared elsewhere.
Website history lasts three months, with earlier campaigns disappearing as the window moves.
Website analytics reuses the existing Cloudflare service instead of adding a paid analytics subscription, with account allowance and storage cost checked before activation.
Website and App are separate dashboard sections, with website date, source, campaign and download-platform controls.
Website trends, traffic sources, campaign results and installer-platform download clicks show interest, not completed installs, while existing app statistics and privacy restrictions stay unchanged.
Website has its own overview, totals and filters, while App stays accessible in a separate tab.
rows.evidence: Fresh isolated dashboard captures exactly match approved S-1 images: docs/active/design/2026-09-14-site-marketing-analytics/runs/after/shots-analytics/meadow-mist/overview.png = scratch/site-analytics-grade/overview-meadow-mist.png (SHA-256 a49a018a55beab12c0f1c62325c4c2f6f9d6ff5724521bb5e926875658b21d1f); docs/active/design/2026-09-14-site-marketing-analytics/runs/after/shots-analytics/light/overview.png = scratch/site-analytics-grade/overview-light.png (SHA-256 4370fa45f6de4c670dd7e321833669de43a6568f0a6d0aa7a9d651e462ca7fd0).

rows.statement: Totals show visits, instructions opened, download clicks and visits’ click rate; repeated clicks increase clicks, but each visit counts once in the rate.
Campaigns show visits, clicks and once-per-visit click rates alongside platform click shares; the platform filter changes only the breakdown.
Source and campaign hints explain shared links; the finished link updates as you type, and Copy link prepares it to share.
